source: OBR Economic and fiscal outlook, October 2026, Annex A, Table A.1: Economy forecast (page 180), percentage change on a year earlier, calendar years
replaces: OBR EFO March 2026 (Table A.1) as shipped in policyengine-uk 2.151.0
years: 2026 to 2031, keyed by calendar year (YYYY-01-01.YYYY-12-31) and applied before data load. 2025 is outturn and is left as shipped; after 2031 the engine's long-run path is kept.
notes: Each series is the Table A.1 row named in 'row'. The engine's March values equal the March 2026 Table A.1 rows (October value minus the Table A.2 change since March, to within 0.1pp rounding). Statutory inputs (cpi_september, awe_total_pay_may_july) keep their published outturns (September 2026 CPI 3.5%, May-July 2026 earnings 3.9%); their forecast years follow these series plus the engine's forecast_gap.
